question: Should the QQBot owner approve this restrictive agent-context policy after reviewing the complete current-main quote/access contract and redacted live behavior for restricted and open conversations?
rationale: The patch deliberately changes what third-party quoted text may reach an agent. The protected maintainer label and security-boundary impact require an owner to confirm the intended balance between disclosure prevention and expected quote context.

options.title: Approve after boundary proof
options.body: Confirm the QQBot access-policy contract and accept the patch once redacted runtime evidence covers restricted blocked, authorized, bot-authored, and open-conversation quote paths.

options.title: Narrow or revise the policy
options.body: Require a different quote-visibility rule if the current QQBot ownership contract distinguishes cache-miss, bot-authored, or group quote cases differently.

options.title: Pause for a canonical QQBot policy change
options.body: Pause this PR if quote-context visibility needs a broader shared policy decision rather than a QQBot-local application.

recommendation.title: Approve after boundary proof
recommendation.body: Confirm the QQBot access-policy contract and accept the patch once redacted runtime evidence covers restricted blocked, authorized, bot-authored, and open-conversation quote paths.

likelyOwner.reason: A concrete current-main QQBot feature-history owner could not be established because repository read commands were unavailable.
